rows.contract: MSL4 supports reading sample textures. Alias-safe native color rendering supports per-sample output.
rows.native_mapping: Test actual SDK rejection of texture2d_ms write and successful native vertex/fragment counterpart under MSL4.
rows.expected_result: Negative capability probe plus native metallib expected.
rows.actual_result: Actual MSL compiler rejects writable texture2d_ms and accepts the per-sample native raster implementation. Packaged bytes and host sample/resolve oracles, PICA and CTest passed.

rows.actual_result: Exact remaining verification is recorded in progress.json.
